description: This Java class 'ProducerPropertiesFactory' is responsible for creating and configuring Kafka producer properties based on a given 'Connection' and 'KafkaConfig'. It includes methods to add metadata, security protocols, and specific configurations required for Kafka producers. The class handles converting plugin-specific configuration structures into flat property maps suitable for Kafka client setup.

classes.name: ProducerPropertiesFactory
classes.description: A factory class to create and manage Kafka producer configuration properties based on given connection and Kafka configuration.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of ProducerPropertiesFactory with specified connection and Kafka configuration.

methods.name: getProducerProperties
methods.description: Generates an unmodifiable map of Kafka producer properties based on the provided configuration and connection.

methods.name: addMetadata
methods.description: Adds identification metadata such as connection ID to the producer properties.

methods.name: addSpecificConfig
methods.description: Applies specific Kafka configuration tweaks via configured KafkaSpecificConfig instances.

methods.name: addSecurityProtocol
methods.description: Determines and sets the appropriate security protocol based on connection authentication status.

methods.name: isConnectionAuthenticated
methods.description: Checks if the provided connection is authenticated for security protocol configuration.

methods.name: addAuthenticatedSecurityProtocol
methods.description: Sets security protocol to SASL_SSL or SASL_PLAINTEXT based on connection security.

methods.name: addUnauthenticatedSecurityProtocol
methods.description: Sets security protocol to SSL or PLAINTEXT for unauthenticated connections.

methods.name: isConnectionSecure
methods.description: Checks whether the connection uses SSL protocol.

methods.name: configToProperties
methods.description: Converts a Config object into a flat map of producer configuration properties.

methods.name: flattenUnwrappedConfig
methods.description: Recursively flattens nested Map structures into a dot-separated path key-value map for Kafka configuration.
